bio: Brent Louis Taylor (born August 9, 1968) is an American politician who has served since 2023 as a member of the Tennessee Senate representing District 31. A member of the Republican Party, he was previously a member of the Memphis City Council from 1995 to 2007. Taylor succeeded Brian Kelsey who had previously pled guilty to campaign finance charges and did not seek re-election.
